name: Leshy, Skunk Cabbage
body:
SKUNK CABBAGE LESHY
CR 5

A purple leafy casing protects this small plant creature, and a pair of smaller casings open up in approximations of hands. A profound stench emanates from within the leshy, to the delight of a dozen circling flies.

XP 1,600
LG Small plant (leshy)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +12
Aura stench (30 ft., DC 16, 1d6 rounds)

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 13, flat-footed 19 (+2 Dex, +8 natural, +1 size)
hp 59 (7d8+28)
Fort +8, Ref +4, Will +4
Immune electricity, plant traits, sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 2 slams +10 (1d4+3 plus overwhelming stench)
Ranged skunk spray +7 touch (1d4 acid and overwhelming stench)
Special Attacks overwhelming stench, verdant channel 3/day (4d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +7)

At-Will—tree shape (small cabbage only)
Constant—pass without trace, speak with plants

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 14, Con 17, Int 8, Wis 14, Cha 11
Base Atk +5; CMB +7; CMD 19
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Toughness, Weapon Focus (slam)
Skills Perception +12, Stealth +6 (+10 Stealth in forest), Survival +2 (+6 Survival in forests); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth and Survival in forests
Languages Common, Druidic, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Overwhelming Stench (Ex)

A creature struck by skunk spray or slam must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or become nauseated for 1 round, and then sickened for 1d4 minutes. On a successful save, the creature is still sickened for 1 round. Dousing the victim in at least a gallon of alcohol removes the stench and ends the nauseated and sickened conditions inflicted by this ability. This is a poison effect. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Skunk Spray (Ex)

Skunk spray is a touch attack which has a range increment of 20 feet and deals 1d4 acid damage.

Verdant Channel (Ex)

Skunk cabbage leshys can channel verdant energy to a range of 30 feet. This acts as channel positive energy, but it can only heal plant creatures and deals no damage to undead.
